prompt: A geostationary object. Name the event, and the first action the governing procedure requires.
plot_description: Sub-satellite longitude against time. The trace holds a station box, then breaks out and drifts steadily in one direction at a new constant rate that persists to the end of the span.
accepted_first_actions: confirm in a second independent fit
confirm the change across two fits
expert_cue: The drift rate changed and stayed changed. A station-keeping correction returns the object to its box; this one leaves it.
